title: From 1D Benchmarks to Complex 3D Geometries: Can Agents Reliably Specify Problems for Automated PDE Simulation?
title_zh: 从一维基准到复杂三维几何：智能体能可靠地为自动化PDE仿真定义问题吗？

paragraphs.en: 提出智能体工作流自动生成PDE模拟JSON规范，结合验证与澄清机制，实现98.3%首轮规范正确率。 Turning an engineering request into a simulation requires consistent geometry, physics, boundary conditions, and numerical settings. Recent agent-assisted systems automate simulation setup, but successful execution alone does not establish whether the specification preserves the intended problem or correctly handles missing information. We study whether agents can reliably construct complete executable JSON specifications for automated geometry creation, meshing, PDE solving, and result export. Our workflow combines model extraction with deterministic scientific and capability checks, explicit clarification, and validated local patches that preserve unrelated accepted fields. We evaluate specification correctness, execution completion, and numerical verification separately. On 120 template-related requests, the full workflow achieves 98.3% correct first-turn specification and decision outcomes, compared with 92.5% for schema-assisted single shot and 82.5% for model-only: gains of 5.8 and 15.8 percentage points, respectively. It makes no false-ready decisions among the 42 requests requiring clarification or rejection. Component ablations identify contributions from scientific checks and conditional repair. Separate downstream studies cover 1D, 2D, and 3D steady and unsteady, linear and nonlinear problems, including flow and elasticity with complex three-dimensional wing geometries. A 30-case gallery demonstrates automated execution from retained JSON specifications, while 9 of 12 selected live user-to-results tests achieve joint specification, execution, export, and numerical-reference success (75.0%). These results support traceable, engineer-reviewed simulation assistance within the tested scope, while fresh-response regressions identify consistency as a priority for further improvement.
paragraphs.zh: 提出智能体工作流自动生成PDE模拟JSON规范，结合验证与澄清机制，实现98.3%首轮规范正确率。将工程请求转化为模拟需要一致的几何、物理、边界条件和数值设置。 近期的智能体辅助系统可以自动化模拟设置，但仅凭成功执行并不能确定规范是否保留了预期问题，或是否正确处理了缺失信息。 我们研究智能体能否可靠地构建完整可执行的JSON规范，用于自动化几何创建、网格划分、PDE求解和结果导出。 我们的工作流将模型提取与确定性的科学和能力检查、显式澄清以及保留无关已接受字段的经校验本地补丁相结合。 我们分别评估规范正确性、执行完成度和数值验证。 在120个模板相关请求上，完整工作流实现98.3%的首轮规范与决策正确率，而模式辅助单次生成为92.5%，仅模型为82.5%：分别提升5.8和15.8个百分点。 在42个需要澄清或拒绝的请求中，它没有做出任何错误的“就绪”决策。 组件消融实验确定了科学检查和条件修复的贡献。 单独的下游研究涵盖一维、二维和三维的稳态与非稳态、线性与非线性问题，包括涉及复杂三维机翼几何的流动和弹性问题。 一个包含30个案例的展示库演示了从保留的JSON规范进行的自动化执行，而12个选定的从用户到结果的实时测试中有9个同时实现规范、执行、导出和数值参考成功（75.0%）。 这些结果支持在测试范围内提供可追溯、经工程师审查的模拟辅助，而全新响应的回归表现则表明一致性是进一步改进的优先事项。
